cohort: 88 women undergoing cesarean section at a single center in Indonesia were randomized into two groups: one receiving TXA and the other placebo.
finding: Intraoperative administration of tranexamic acid significantly reduces postpartum blood loss and the risk of postpartum hemorrhage in women undergoing cesarean sections.
mod_finding: Intraoperative TXA significantly reduces blood loss and PPH in women undergoing cesarean sections.
